title: Glowing magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='starGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe0' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffe36b' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb02e' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='tipGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#a8e6ff' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fc3f7' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='30' fill='url(#starGlow)'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <polygon points='84,10 86,16 92,18 86,20 84,26 82,20 76,18 82,16' opacity='0.9'/>
    <polygon points='90,36 91.5,40 95.5,41.5 91.5,43 90,47 88.5,43 84.5,41.5 88.5,40' opacity='0.8'/>
    <polygon points='80,44 81,47 84,48 81,49 80,52 79,49 76,48 79,47' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- wand stick -->
  <g transform='rotate(45 50 50)'>
    <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='44' rx='4' fill='#8d4b1f'/>
    <rect x='46' y='52' width='3' height='44' rx='1.5' fill='#b5662e'/>
    <rect x='46' y='84' width='8' height='7' rx='3' fill='#5c2f12'/>
    <rect x='46' y='52' width='8' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c07a3e'/>
  </g>

  <!-- wand tip glow halo -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='32' r='15' fill='url(#tipGlow)'/>

  <!-- star tip -->
  <polygon points='68,16 71,27 82,27 73,34 76,45 68,38 60,45 63,34 54,27 65,27'
           fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <polygon points='68,16 71,27 82,27 73,34 76,45 68,38 60,45 63,34 54,27 65,27'
           fill='none' stroke='#fff8c4' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='68,22 69.5,27 75,28.5 70.5,32 71.5,37.5 68,34 64.5,37.5 65.5,32 61,28.5 66.5,27'
           fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
